name: Orca
source:
Orca is a special type of android that focuses on rescue missions and disaster relief. She has a tail which helps with removing debris and can also equip heavy armor to aid her in harsh conditions.

After moving to Chroma City because of her job, she became a customer at D1AL-ogue.
